sections.heading: Perfume Box with Bottle Insert FAQ
sections.text: Questions Perfume Box with Bottle Insert FAQ How is the insert sized to my bottle? From your bottle drawing or a sample bottle, including the cap. The cavity follows the bottle's outline so it sits firmly without pressing on the cap or spray head. Satin, EVA or paperboard insert? A satin-covered insert gives the classic luxury look. EVA foam holds heavy glass most firmly. Paperboard keeps the box paper-based. All three are quoted from the same box size. Can one box hold a bottle and a travel atomizer? Yes. A second cavity can hold a travel atomizer, discovery vials or a card next to the main bottle. What is the minimum order? 100 pcs per custom size. A physical sample takes 3–5 business days and bulk production 12–15 days after sample approval. Do you supply the bottles? No. We make the box and insert; bottles and caps come from your own supplier.
